items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Gable came down to Louis' and he had to sit there and wait til I was finished giving Louis a lesson.

ctx.x: Yeah, it looks like air would escape.

Yeah, that's what I -- yeah, now you got the idea. Now, I'm a trumpet teacher, and in fact, sort of like Gable, when I was working out with Louis. You know, Louis came back from France, and this was the time for this other band that I was talking about --
Yes, Yes, let's go into that, (inaudible)
